_why: Intake runs as a five-pass pipeline (app/intake.py), not a tool loop. Pass 1 writes characters.md, world.md and story.md in three parallel calls, each given the whole material and its own output budget, because one reply covering several long files comes back compressed. Pass 2 writes open-items.md with no research in reach; pass 3 adds options from the shelf; the run then stops for the showrunner. Pass 4 revises the three files in parallel and pass 5 derives facts.md. So: a big context window, and max_tokens near the model's ceiling - a file that runs long should run long rather than come back cut off. Cold: this is reading and organizing, not invention. Whatever the model returns is used; the room repairs formatting afterwards and only an empty reply is worth another call. "max_steps" and "references" do not apply. The visual check (app/visual.py) runs on the same settings plus image_model: OpenRouter's /images endpoint, with aspect_ratio and resolution in image_extra.
_help: Committed. Provider and model are usually set in the UI (⚙ Model). null = the .env default. API keys never go here: they're saved per provider in secrets/keys.json.
